_comment: Known high/critical advisories in PRODUCTION dependencies that this
deployment accepts for now. Read by scripts/audit.mjs, which fails CI on
anything not listed here and on any entry whose review date has passed.
Same bargain as .trivyignore.yaml: a reason somebody can disagree with,
and a date when it comes back. Every entry below needs a semver-major
upgrade of a framework dependency, which is a deliberate piece of work
rather than something to slip into an unrelated change.

postcss.advisory: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output
postcss.reason: Build-time only. postcss runs in the Next/Tailwind build on our own stylesheets; no student input ever reaches it, and it is not part of the worker bundle served to a browser. The fix is next@16, a major upgrade of the framework.

undici.advisory: Unbounded decompression chain in HTTP responses via Content-Encoding
undici.reason: Transitive under @ai-sdk/deepseek. Production runs on Cloudflare Workers, where the platform's own fetch is used and undici is not in the request path; it is reachable only from Node during build and test. The fix is @ai-sdk/deepseek@3, a major upgrade whose API this app pins deliberately.
